What's new in 4.0.0

New

• Added iPhone Duo support with a full screen layout and landscape when unfolded
• Added an Enable iPhone Duo Support signing experiment
• Added update choices: tapping Update lists every source that has the app with its version and description, and you can pin a source to update from it automatically
• Added Update, View in Sources and Reset Update Source to the Library app menu
• Added an Update line under Library apps that have a newer version, can be turned off from the Library filter menu
• Added an Updates filter to the Library
• Added update options in Settings › Sources: always take the newest version, skip the choice when only one source has the app, group updates by app and check on launch
• Added offline sources: repositories open instantly from a saved copy, with refresh and cache options in Settings › Sources
• Added favorite repositories, pinned in their own section at the top of Sources
• Added sorting for repositories by name, app count or date added
• Added app counts to repositories, can be turned off in Settings › Sources
• Added news from every source to All Repositories, can be turned off in Settings › Sources
• Added an option to delete older versions of an app after installing an update, kept by default
• Added an on-device certificate for local installs, so installing no longer depends on a downloaded certificate
• Added Detect Failed Installs in Installation settings, so updates iOS refuses show an error instead of completing
• Added Minimum OS and entitlements to app info
• Added a confirmation before installing from a link
• Added Block Sandbox Escape and Remove App Groups signing options to protect against the bad_query and worse_query exploits

Improvements

• Improved update checks: one row per Library app, the same count everywhere and faster checks on large sources
• Improved installs: the app is packed at full priority and without compression
• Improved install queues: a failed install no longer stops the rest and failures are listed at the end
• Improved install errors: failed installs show Failed with a Details button, and batch failures can be tapped to read the full error
• Improved Settings with Signing, Files and Storage groups and one Automatic Cleanup screen
• Improved filter menus in Library and Sources with icons, sort order and quick toggles
• Improved Tab Bar settings with drag handles to reorder tabs
• Improved the install sheet to follow your accent color and appearance
• Sources now load at launch and refresh every 30 minutes by default, so Library updates show without opening Sources
• SSL certificates for local installs now refresh automatically once a week
• Automatic cleanup now picks up where it left off if the app is closed mid way
• Updated the signing engine

Fixes

• Fixed RyukSign draining battery in the background after an install finished
• Fixed every install leaving a full copy of the app in temporary storage until the next launch
• Fixed updating an app not clearing its update, including tweaked builds that report a different version
• Fixed updates matching unrelated apps that only share a name
• Fixed the install sheet hanging on Ready when the install prompt never appears or is dismissed
• Fixed installs getting stuck when iOS refuses the install link, the backup install page opens again
• Fixed a blank page when opening the backup install page during batch installs
• Fixed Delete After Installing removing an app while its install card was still open
• Fixed a crash when several downloads finish importing at the same time
• Fixed downloads sometimes getting stuck on Starting
• Fixed a crash when shrinking an iPad window while a sidebar only tab was open
• Fixed All Repositories and repository tabs staying empty when opened from the iPad sidebar
• Fixed Certificates sometimes not opening from the iPad sidebar
• Fixed All Repositories showing a load error instead of an empty state when no sources are added…

Needs: a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see Signing in the README.

Worse Query Files 0.9.6

New

• Search Inside Folders… (••• menu): finds names in all subfolders, with progress and Stop.
• Largest Files (••• menu): the 100 biggest files below a folder, to see where storage goes.
• Get Info (long-press): path, kind, size (folders counted), dates, owner, permissions, inode and a file's SHA-256. Tap a row to copy it.
• Duplicate and Copy to Folder… (long-press): copy files and folders, also into other apps' data, like Move.
• Favorites: add a folder from its ••• menu; they're listed under Tools.
• Reopen Last Folder (#41): WQ Files starts in the folder you were in. It's a switch on the start screen.
• Check for Updates (#41): a note on the start screen when a new version is out.
• What's sent: WQ Files reads the public release list on GitHub at most twice a day and sends nothing about your device. This is its only network access.
• Turning it off: use the switch on the start screen.
• Open ZIP files by tapping them (#41): Extract and Open unpacks it next to itself and opens the folder. Open as File shows the file as before.
• Thai (#52).

Changed

• SQLite save writes through SQLite itself, which takes care of the database's journal and WAL files, so a save is safer if WQ Files is closed midway.
• App restore copies and checks the backup in a private folder first, and installs exactly what was checked.
• Replace All when importing only replaces the file versions shown in the question; a file that changed meanwhile is imported under a new name.
• Turkish and Thai: clearer wording.

Fixed

• App names and some app folders missing on some devices (e.g. iOS 26.1): when the app database uses a layout WQ Files doesn't know, it now works out where names and folders are from the database itself, and remembers it for that iOS version. App identities, which decide where backups go, still only come from the app's own folder tag or a known layout. WQ Files also uses the newest database file when iOS keeps an old one, and the Log lists them.
• App backups could come out empty when WQ Files didn't have access to the app's folder yet; it worked on the second or third try. Backup now fails with "try again" instead, and an empty backup is never restored (restoring one would empty the app's data).

Credit

Sandbox technique: worse_query by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: KAMUI by murk-sus. Translations: iosrxwy (Simplified Chinese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian). Thanks to everyone who sent Logs and ideas. GPL-3.0-or-later.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

• macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
• Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
• Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
• RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
• Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
• Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
• iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

• Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
• iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

What's new
• microVU0: compute the VU1 register window's address at run time
• Tests: a persisted VU0 program that uses the window onto VU1's registers
• Android: link the core with emulated TLS when the minimum API is below 29
• iOS: give the layout editor and the manifest skin their own views
• iOS: split the patch and skin library stores by their own sections
• iOS: split navigation and gameplay views into one file per view
• iOS: split the controls and skin files along their types
• iOS: split the dynamic backgrounds into one file per background

versions.localizedDescription:
BCD is in alpha: an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

This build brings everything since 0.1.634: external drives, Windows Vulkan for 64-bit games (experimental, per game), Ubisoft Connect with Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4, a native interface for the foldable iPhone (experimental), colour profiles, many Direct3D 9, 11 and 12 fixes, Steam (BCD Dock) fixes, recommended settings for 60 more games and over 150 new Auto-tune rules.

New

• New icon: BCD has a new app icon by Mila (mudcatpot), with versions for iOS's dark and tinted home screens. Thank you, Mila!
• External drives: Settings › Storage › External drives › Add a drive or folder adds a drive (a USB-C SSD or a stick) or a folder on it; you can add several. Each drive appears in Windows as C:\External\<name> and as a drive letter.
• Find games adds the games on a drive to your library, and the drive's Steam libraries are found by themselves: their games start through BCD Dock like any other Steam game.
• A Steam game's page offers External drive for a new install (Steam installs in the same settings picks the default place), and Steam updates and repairs a game in the library it lives in.
• Location › Move to on a game's page moves a Steam game, or a game you added from Files, between the device and a drive: it copies the game, checks the copy, then deletes the original. The game keeps its settings, Workshop items and launch options.
• Before a download, files already on the disk are checked once, so a repaired or moved game is not downloaded again.
• The earlier External SSD folder becomes a drive by itself, with its games and their settings. If it does not open at the first start, BCD tries again at the next start or at Play.
• Reconnect opens a drive again after it was unplugged; Remove forgets it.
• Windows Vulkan (experimental, 64-bit games): a game's page has Direct3D › Vulkan (experimental). With it, a 64-bit game that draws with Vulkan gets Vulkan through MoltenVK (vulkan = moltenvk). Off by default; turn it on per game.
• Ubisoft Connect, Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4:
• Ubisoft Connect no longer stops right after its start.
• Its built-in browser runs with fewer processes, so it fits.
• Its installer is not run again for every Ubisoft game once the launcher is installed.
• A game started through it gets the settings the launcher needs for that session only.
• Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4 have recommended settings.
• Foldable iPhone (experimental): Settings › Graphics › Foldable iPhone has two switches, both off by default and both changing nothing on other iPhones and iPads.
• Duo enhancements gives BCD a native interface with Liquid Glass, system tabs and a sidebar, search in the Library and controller navigation. The Windows desktop's Start, Open and Stop sit on Home, and downloads resume when the desktop runs in the background.
• Foldable iPhone support starts a game you add at a resolution shaped like the inner display, and the touch controls follow the screen when you fold or unfold the phone.
• Installed directly, iOS shows BCD in a small window on the inner display; inside LiveContainer it fills the screen. Both switches apply from the next start of BCD.
• Colour profiles: Settings › Appearance picks BCD's colours. The default look is unchanged.
• Xbox 360 controller identity: Controls › Controller API › Xbox 360 controller (XInput + device) on a game's page keeps the XInput pad and also lists it as an Xbox 360 controller, for a game that shows no controller otherwise (Far Cry 4).
• Aim with a stick: an aim zone can drive the right stick instead of the mouse (Aim mode › The finger moves › The right stick on a game's page), for a game that ignores the mouse while a controller is in use (NieR).

Fixes and improvements…

versions.localizedDescription:
RewindBox 0.0.11 — Build 721

Everything since RewindBox 0.0.10 (Build 559), brought together in one update.

🎮 PlayStation 3 — RPCS3

• Assassin’s Creed: audio mixing corrections prevent audio periods from being discarded during waits.
• Reduced redundant rendering interruptions and repeated graphics work, including changes to Vulkan/MoltenVK.
• Improved texture caching to reuse more previously calculated results.
• Black Ops II: corrections to SPU synchronization, memory reservations and waits involved in stalls.
• Black Ops II: earlier submission of pending occlusion results, with a separate bounded budget, targets waits on the game’s main CPU threads.
• Corrected short active-wait timing on iPhones with a 1 GHz system counter and adjusted the BO2 writer-lock wait path.
• Assassin’s Creed: corrected an atomic SPU write that could overwrite a newer main-CPU value during game exit.
• Improved SPU program preparation and cache reuse to reduce recompilation during gameplay.
• God of War III: removed the unintended 30 FPS limit and reduced unnecessary texture validation.
• God of War III v1.00: the optional MLAA bypass now applies on a fresh boot as well.
• Assassin’s Creed IV and Dynasty Warriors 6: corrected game profiles to use the LLVM PPU recompiler.
• Corrected texture coherence, partial graphics commands and CPU/GPU synchronization paths.
• More reliable retention of mounted ISO images.
• Corrected JIT memory reservation when the usual address range is unavailable, including on certain iOS beta versions.
• Repositioned the Menu and Performance buttons to better respect touch controls and safe areas.
• Expanded per-game settings and diagnostic tools to identify the causes of stalls more precisely.

🕹️ Nintendo Switch — MeloNX

• Support for the keyboard requested by games, plus touch access to L3/R3.
• Corrected controller handling during sessions and when returning to the interface.
• First-frame and GPU-transfer corrections targeting black screens at launch.
• Graphics ordering corrections targeting stale frames, flickering and rendering artifacts.
• Corrected shader resource declarations and compilation paths that could prevent parts of a scene from rendering.
• JIT corrections covering branches, translation-block boundaries and register-state preservation.
• Fewer repeated allocations, improved texture reuse and release of resources no longer needed.
• Improved memory-pressure handling and cleanup of resources retained after closing a session.
• More durable shader and pipeline caches: saves during gameplay and on pause, background loading and improved reuse between sessions.
• Preparation of previously encountered graphics variants to reduce their reconstruction during gameplay.
• Reduced redundant graphics-resource updates and improved sharing of Metal libraries between compilation workers.
• Hogwarts Legacy corrections covering texture copies and handling of certain invalid graphics values.
• Failure to start the iOS audio engine no longer directly aborts the application.
• Compilation cancellation during teardown addresses sessions stuck on “closing,” including the SSBU path.
• Corrected a MoltenVK presentation ownership race: an in-flight presentation retains the drawable it needs.
• Added a fragmentation guard to avoid unnecessary blocking memory cleanup, targeting pauses reproduced from Super Smash Bros. Ultimate logs.

🎨 Skins and touch controls

• Added GameCube Pocket, Wii Pocket and PS2 Pocket skins.
• Added Pocket — Original variants for GameCube, Wii and PS2 while keeping the existing designs.
• Added Switch Pocket, available through Skins in the Switch playlist menu.
• Portrait and landscape layouts, with orientation locking where supported by the selected skin and engine.
• Corrected offsets between the drawn buttons and their touch areas.
• Corrected rectangular press highlights, pressed states and analog-stick geometry.
• GameCube/Wii analog sticks now move as a complete circle, including the C-stick.…

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

改进

• 温度可以显示为华氏度。 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
• 充电预估。 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
• 显示版本号。 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
• iPad 布局。 iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
• iPad 热力图。 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

修复

• 发热：CPU 簇（pACC、eACC）和图像处理器（ISP）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 FrontCameraDie、BCMLBSkin 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
• 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

注意

• iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
• iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份充电时导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
• 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

Improvements

• Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit. Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
• Charge forecast. While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
• Version number. Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
• iPad layout. On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
• iPad heat map. On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

Fixes

• Thermal: the CPU-cluster (pACC, eACC) and image-processor (ISP) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as FrontCameraDie and BCMLBSkin were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
• Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

Notes

• The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
• The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken while charging. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
• The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

• Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
• To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
• Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
• Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

• Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

• Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
• Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
• Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

• A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
• Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.

若您在启动游戏时遇到闪退、黑屏、直接崩溃等问题，请更新至该版本。
同时新增 AI 助手、启动时自动检查更新等功能。26.2 与 26.3 都可以正常使用,请悉知.

更新内容
• 新增 AI 助手:可以和你对话,也能帮你找资源、装模组/整合包/光影,还能读取游戏日志、分析崩溃原因 @herbrine8403
• 新增 启动时自动检查更新:有新版本会自动提示,并显示可滚动的更新说明 @yitenchen123
• 适配 Minecraft 26.3(SDL3 窗口/输入/呈现层):修复进入游戏黑屏、画面缩在角落、小窗显示错位、Vulkan 下帧率一直显示为 0、物品栏点不动、快捷栏按键错位等问题 @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403
• 修复 MobileGlues 渲染器在 26.3 下闪退的深层原因 @yiyeshi0-hash
• 支持 Metal(metallum)渲染器,可用于 Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash
• 新增 MobileGL / MobileGL-gles 渲染器,并新增 SimpleFPEWrapper(sfpew) 以支持 1.17 及以下版本(请在设置中开启 sfpew,并在渲染器中选择 MobileGL-gles);同时修复 MobileGlues 在 26.3 下的闪退与黑屏 @yitenchen123
• MobileGlues 内置源码升级到上游 2.0.x,着色器转换链不再互相干扰 @yitenchen123
• 引入 LWJGL 3.3.3 / 3.4.1 两套运行库看，可按游戏版本自动选择或手动选择 @yitenchen123 @herbrine8403
• 修复 Forge / NeoForge 直装时的启动器被关闭、直装后闪退、模块冲突等问题 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
• 修复 OptiFine 直装、整合包导入,以及下载源和镜像相关的报错 @yitenchen123
• 修复 JIT 相关问题:开启 JIT 后启动不再闪退(含使用外部 JIT 后启动闪退的情况),并新增 JIT 工具选择 @herbrine8403 @yiyeshi0-hash
• 优化内存占用:自动识别大内存权限,减少后台内存回收导致的闪退 @herbrine8403 @yitenchen123
• 补全简体中文缺失的文本,并同步 Crowdin @herbrine8403
• 改进构建与打包流程:双版本运行库、复用已编译组件、构建日志更清晰 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
• 其他内容请前往 Commit 界面查看

注意事项

若要在 Minecraft 26.3 上使用 Vulkan,请把渲染器选为 Zink,同时把渲染 API 改为 Vulkan。

Air 5.1.0

This update is mainly about Minecraft 26.3 support and fixes several issues including JIT startup crashes;
it also adds an AI assistant and an automatic update check on launch. Both 26.2 and 26.3 work fine.

Changelog
• Added an AI assistant: chat with it, let it find and install mods / modpacks / shaders, and let it read game logs and explain crashes @herbrine8403
• Added an automatic update check on launch: you get notified when a new version is out, with scrollable release notes @yitenchen123
• Added Minecraft 26.3 support (SDL3 window / input / presentation): fixed the black screen on entering a world, the picture stuck in a corner, having to change the resolution once to get a picture, wrong display in small windows, frame rate always showing 0 with Vulkan, resolution switching not working, the on-screen keyboard and control buttons not typing, the inventory not being clickable, and wrong hotbar keys @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403
• Fixed why the MobileGlues renderer crashed on 26.3: a render hook mistook itself for the real implementation and kept calling itself until it crashed @yiyeshi0-hash
• Added Metal (metallum) renderer support for Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash
• Added the MobileGL / MobileGL-gles renderers, and SimpleFPEWrapper (sfpew) to support 1.17 and below (enable sfpew in the settings and pick MobileGL-gles as the renderer); also fixed MobileGlues crashes and black screens on 26.3 @yitenchen123
• Upgraded the built-in MobileGlues sources to upstream 2.0.x; the shader conversion chain no longer interferes with itself @yitenchen123
• Added two sets of LWJGL runtime libraries (3.3.3 / 3.4.1), picked automatically by game version @yitenchen123
• Fixed Forge / NeoForge direct install issues: launcher being closed during install, crash right after install, and module conflicts @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
• Fixed OptiFine direct install, modpack import, and download source / mirror errors @yitenchen123
• Fixed JIT issues: enabling JIT (including using an external JIT) no longer crashes the launcher on start, plus a new JIT tool option @herbrine8403 @yiyeshi0-hash…
